item.title: Fairfax County Fire mourns death of ‘unwaveringly dedicated’ 20-year veteran firefighter after brief illness
item.description: Fairfax County Fire and Rescue is remembering Firefighter Brandon Winfield as a dedicated public servant, mentor and friend following his death Thursday.

item.title: 19-year-old Shepherd University student killed in off-campus shooting; suspect charged with murder
item.description: A 19-year-old Shepherd University student was shot and killed in an off-campus apartment early Friday. A suspect has been arrested and charged with murder.

item.title: One killed after trash truck hit-and-run in Northwest DC
item.description: Two women were hit by what officials believe is a trash truck Friday afternoon. Officials say two pedestrians were struck at the intersection of Upshur Street and Georgia Ave in Petworth around 2:00 p.m. on Friday. The victims have been identified as two adult females. Both were on an electric bike together when they were struck. One woman died at the scene, per officials. The vehicle fled the scene, per officials. item.title: Suspect in custody after Springfield Mall shooting
item.description: A suspect is in custody after a shooting at the Springfield Town Center Friday evening. Officers were on the scene of a shooting in the 6500 block of Springfield Mall Friday.An adult man was taken to the hospital for treatment of non-life-threatening injuries. A gun has been recovered on the scene. There is no threat to the shopping center and the scene is secure, per officials. This is a developing story. Stay with FOX 5 DC for the latest.

item.title: Former police chief pleads guilty to arson in Montgomery County
item.description: A former police chief who once swore to protect the public is now a convicted arsonist.David Michael Crawford pleaded guilty on Friday on multiple arson counts in Montgomery County. The judge found Crawford guilty on Counts 1, 4, and 6 — tied to a series of deliberate fires. One of those fires happened while his pregnant daughter-in-law and children were inside.
